assetOrigin: Original procedural mesh and animation, with no third-party mesh or texture inputs.

artDirection.silhouette: Deep narrow hood, angular cracked ash mask, dim green eye slits, elongated fingers, tattered mantle and mist tails.
artDirection.drain: The hands reach forward and coiled mint energy travels from the host side toward the mantle clasp.
artDirection.death: The figure folds inward and dissolves in place, with six thin jade-green wisps lifting and fading.

standardization.rig: Articulated glTF node hierarchy with baked TRS channels

attachment.customization: An optional descendant anchor and an anchor-local offset supplied by each host.

anchorContractNote: 原 anchors 指向的结构空节点（HeadAnchor 等 5 个）在 Issue #108 optimize 时被 prune（运行时无引用）；GLB 几何/动画/材质契约不受影响。
